sql: SELECT document_number,title,publication_date::VARCHAR publication_date,effective_on::VARCHAR effective_on,citation,html_url,listing_hash,length(full_text) text_length FROM documents WHERE publication_date>=DATE '2025-10-17' AND publication_date<=DATE '2026-10-22' AND (full_text LIKE '%10984%' OR title ILIKE '%heavy%duty%' OR title ILIKE '%medium%duty%') ORDER BY publication_date,document_number
